reason:
I rebuilt the whole computation without looking at the author's work. Under each world, each count follows the exact rational beta-binomial or binomial-mixture pmf (Fractions). I computed the per-type Bhattacharyya affinities at 60 digits with mpmath and took the bound as 1-sqrt(1-(rho0^100 rho1^100)^2). I computed the NP minimum 1-TV = E_a[min(1,LR)] two ways: exactly, by FFT convolution of the per-prefix log-LR distribution over 200 prefixes (grid h about 1e-4, mass sums to 1 within 1e-13), and by Monte Carlo with up to 4M pilots. I also checked the exact moments of F_c2: mean 1/5 and 1/4, variance 4/2525 and 3/1616, the same as Beta(20,80) and Beta(25,75).

Hellinger values all match to the quoted digits: 0.41943 (F_b, m=32), 0.81069 (F_c2), 0.03233 and 0.00027 (F_b at m=128 and m=512), 0.08192 and the type-0-only 0.22349 (point mass at the means), and 0.7156/0.4518/0.2419 (F_theta at m=128). The claim never defines F_theta. I recovered it by search: Beta with the same mean and variance theta*Var_a, i.e. a+b+1 = 101/theta. A mixture definition or a theta^2 variance scaling does not match.

Exact NP minima from FFT: F_b gives 0.52168, 0.09674 and 0.00595 at m=32/128/512. F_c2 gives 0.85152 at m=32 and 0.16592 at m=128. F_theta gives 0.7717/0.5501/0.3553 at m=128 and 0.6584/0.3546 at m=512. The point mass gives 0.17368. Almost all claimed MC values are within 1.5 SE of these. The theory is standard and correct: the minimum over randomized rules of P_a(no cert)+P_b(cert) is 1-TV, the LR test attains it, TV <= sqrt(1-BC^2), and P_a(cert) <= TV+gamma.

Defects found:
(1) Mislabel. The claim says 0.569 is "the TYPE-0 FACTOR rho_0^{100} alone". In fact rho_0^100 = 0.90252. The 0.56936 is the type-0-only Hellinger bound 1-sqrt(1-rho_0^200).
(2) The F_c2 m=32 NP value 0.8537+-0.0016 is 1.4 SE above the exact 0.85152. As a result the corollary's "at most 19.6%" is not what TV+gamma gives: the exact TV+0.05 is 0.1985. The statement is still true, because the exact NP power at P_b(cert)=0.05 is only 0.111, but the stated derivation does not deliver 19.6%. The F_b figure (0.528 exact vs 0.529) is fine.
(3) The F_c2 m=128 value 0.1638 has no SE and is about 0.0021 below the exact 0.1659 (about 2.4 MC SE). F_b m=32 seed 1 (0.5210) is also below the exact value. So the description "upper bounds on the minimum" (ties counted as not certify) is false for the reported numbers: they are noisy estimates on both sides.
(4) F_theta and the point mass F_c are used but never defined in the claim.
(5) Minor: "the square root being the only irrational step" is wrong, since every term of the affinity sum is a square root.

None of these breaks the lower-bound theorem or its qualitative conclusions.
